p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer controls everything from seller’s factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-certified goods to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; after that, risk and cost are the buyer’s.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays for freight and insurance to port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers to the destination, the buyer pays the import duties.
